newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in improved trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian shares mixed in improved trade.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi Arabian stock exchange ended last week mixed in improved trade focused on banking sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index ended 2.48 percent higher at 145.77 points from the previous week's 142.24 points.

BFA said banking sector shares accounted for 28 percent of trading volume put at about four million shares. Trading value was put at 941.05 million riyals ($251 million) from 780.18 million riyals a week earlier.
Of the 61 companies traded, share prices of 25 rose, 25 fell and 11 were unchanged, BFA said.

Among major gainers in the week were Saudi Arabian Fertiliser Co (SAFCO) which ended 12.5 percent higher at 694 riyals from a previous 617 riyals, and Arab National Bank which closed 7.4 percent stronger at 479 riyals from 446 riyals.
